about_the_game:
As a thank you to all DreadOut Remastered Collection players, the DreadOut Remastered Soundtrack & Manga Collection is also available for free. Step beyond the main game and uncover Linda’s untold stories, the official manga, and the haunting soundtrack that shaped her world.

DreadOut: The Untolds

A collection of the DreadOut: The Untolds webcomic, revealing hidden fragments of Linda’s journey during the events of the first DreadOut.

  • 12 episodes in high-resolution JPG format

DreadOut Manga

The official DreadOut manga, written and illustrated by various Indonesian writers and artists.

  • contains 100+ pages of stories based on DreadOut

  • Available in PDF format

20 Tracks of Music Soundtracks.

Experience the haunting music of DreadOut with an eclectic mix of Indonesian indie bands and atmospheric compositions.

The Official Soundtracks in both MP3 and WAV formats, with music from various Indonesian indie bands.

1. Mocca - Lucky Me
2. Koil - Suaramu Merdu
3. Sarasvati - Bilur
4. Sarasvati feat. Trah Project - Gloomy Sunday
5. Koil - Semoga Kau Sembuh part I
6. Tesla Manaf & Mahagotra Ganesha - Disequilibrium
7. Sigmun - Land of the Living Dead
8. Koil - Dan Cinta Kita Terlupakan
9. Sarasvati - KARAM
10. Sarasvati - Takut

Also includes the original DreadOut OST, composed and arranged by Adhitia Sulistiana Wibisana & Pratama Kusuma Putra, featuring Risa Saraswati

DreadOut BGM - Animus Corpus
DreadOut BGM - Malivolus Inimicus
DreadOut BGM - Insidiae Fatum
DreadOut BGM - Tacitus Noctii
DreadOut BGM - Gigantus Mutandis
DreadOut BGM - Compendium Detractus
Risa Saraswati - Lingsir Wengi
DreadOut BGM - Ayun Ambing
DreadOut BGM - Bring Brung
DreadOut BGM - Centreng Saur

Where to Find the DLC

Explore the game installation location and open the folder "DLC - Manga Soundtrack"
